title: W11169652 — Component activation: vent fan
description: Activate vent fan for live verification (LCD combo-fan load; console note).

steps.title: Console control panel?
steps.body: Console models use membrane buttons and a seven-segment display. LCD-in-door models use the TOOLS menu and touchscreen — answer No for those.

steps.title: Console — enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Enter Service Diagnostic mode. Console models have no dedicated vent-fan load function — after reconnecting J12, observe rear vent airflow during a dry cycle, or run Quick Service Cycle after repair to verify.

steps.title: LCD — enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Enter DIAGNOSTICS HOME via TOOLS → INFO → SERVICE & SUPPORT (password 123 × 3).

steps.title: LCD — toggle Dry Heater & Combo Fan ON
steps.body: Component Activation → turn Dry Heater & Combo Fan ON. On LCD models only the fan activates (dry heater element is deactivated in diagnostics). Confirm vent fan spins at rear. Toggle OFF when finished.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Turn Dry Heater* and Combo Fan On — *dry heater deactivated on LCD; only Fan will be activated.
